prompt: Design a premium social-media advertisement for ZipPilot, a shared neighborhood direct-mail service. Brand style: deep navy blue background (#0A1E3C), bright blue (#2F80ED) and vivid green (#5BC236) accents, clean modern sans-serif typography, high contrast, professional advertising quality. Include the provided ZipPilot logo mark (blue location pin with a house and green growth arrow) at the top with the wordmark 'ZipPilot' shown with 'Zip' in white and 'Pilot' in bright blue. All text must be spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible.  Layout: a smartphone scanning a large QR code printed on a navy mailer card, with a floating analytics dashboard panel showing '247 scans' and '32 promos redeemed' beside a green upward trend line. Headline in bold white: 'Direct mail you can finally track.' Subheadline in light blue: 'Every card links to your own promo page.' Bottom: green pill button 'See How It Works' and URL 'TheZipPilot.com' in white.
